module signal_generator (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    output reg [4:0] wave
);

reg [1:0] state;
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if(~rst_n) begin
        state <= 2'b00;
        wave <= 5'b0;
    end
    else begin
        case(state)
            2'b00: begin
                if(wave == 5'b11111) begin
                    state <= 2'b01;
                end
                else begin
                    wave <= wave + 1;
                end
            end
            2'b01: begin
                if(wave == 5'b00000) begin
                    state <= 2'b00;
                end
                else begin
                    wave <= wave - 1;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Triangle Wave Signal Generator</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">Generated waveform signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="0">Initial state for waveform generation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="1">Transition state for waveform generation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">Register to store the current state of the waveform generation process.</reg>
        <reg id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">Register to store the generated waveform signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or the negative edge of the reset signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: set state to 0 and wave to 0
                state <= 0;
                wave <= 0;
            end else begin
                // State machine to generate the triangle wave pattern
                case(state)
                    0: begin
                        // Increment the wave value by 1
                        wave <= wave + 1;
                        // Check if the wave value has reached its maximum value (31)
                        if(wave == 31) begin
                            // Transition to the next state (1)
                            state <= 1;
                        end
                    end
                    1: begin
                        // Decrement the wave value by 1
                        wave <= wave - 1;
                        // Check if the wave value has reached its minimum value (0)
                        if(wave == 0) begin
                            // Transition back to the initial state (0)
                            state <= 0;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
